verdict: No paid activity this period; organic engagement is also declining.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Google Business Profiles were the only active channel, generating 177 total actions across three locations — but no paid ads ran on Meta or Google, meaning zero leads were produced through paid channels this period. GBP engagement dropped 31% in the most recent 7 days versus the prior 7 days, and that decline has continued into this week, so the trend is confirmed rather than a one-day fluctuation. Of the 177 profile actions, the large majority were direction requests (143), while phone calls across all three locations totaled just 8 — call rates remain very low relative to impressions. Paid campaigns are being reactivated to restore the lead pipeline, and GBP profiles are being reviewed to improve call engagement. Expect a return to active lead flow once paid channels are back on.
